what: Bound to Proceed, state 3 (2026-11-27): the check. The work's claims read a second time against their sources, the weakest chased to its source, the critique of 26 November answered. Verdicts are this practice's reading; every figure here is recounted by check.py from the Field's files at their commits and from passages found again.

items.claim: Over the public bodies no text gives anyone a power, so the public receiver is not even answerable.
finding: Older public law gives others that power. When the European Ombudsman finds maladministration, the Commission, its AI Office included,
. A California court may issue a writ
; and the state's AI law does enjoin one act on receipt:

The office's deputy director answered legislators at a hearing on 10 August. The public receiver is answerable, as the maker is, by laws older than any rule on AI. What no text gives the sender is an answer owed to it.

items.claim: All 8 reasons were given by choice.
finding: Read by their own records, 3 were given by choice: a technical report, a social post, a statement to a newspaper. 5 answered a demand from elsewhere: legislators at a hearing (1); the report the law asks of the maker,
, which asks for no reason (2); and the Governor's executive order of 18 September (2). None answered a rule of receipt: no text in the log asks a receiver why.

items.claim: A spokesperson of the state office said at the hearing of 10 August that the law is not meant to make every such incident reportable.
finding: The newspaper prints it as a statement to the paper:
. The entry now stands by 9 September, 55 days after the first public account.

That counted publication, not writing. Each reason stands in a record made public 25 to 123 days after the word; whether anyone wrote a reason down at the time is not on record, and the Californian's log was private too. For the public bodies, which no report reached, the word is dated from the first public account. The tile now says what it counts: on record at the hour.

items.claim: None of the 11 public bodies must answer the sender, keep a clock on receipt, or face anything if it stays silent.
finding: Three of the 11 rest on voluntary texts that bind no government: the Paris Call twice and the EU Code of Practice. Cut to the span that compares, the 8 public bodies a law names: none must answer the sender, none has a clock for a single report, none faces a consequence for silence. Recounted from the Field's own file, not from this work's build.

items.claim: The AI instruments do the reverse of the sea: they bind the sender and give the receivers powers.
finding: Like with like, the sea's own public receivers have the same blanks. The flag State that gets a report:
It has no clock, owes no reason and faces nothing if silent; the coast station is only recommended to answer. And the sea binds the ship that did the harm, as the AI laws bind the maker:
. What the sea has and the AI texts lack is a rule for the bystander placed to help.

items.claim: The reason the sea's rule asks for is a circumstance; the 2026 reasons are classes.
finding: The regulation accepts a reason when the master,

. 'Not required' comes close to 'unnecessary'; 'a circumstance' was this work's word for its phrase. The sea's rule does not forbid a reason of class. What it adds is the hour, the ship's own log, and the rescue service,

items.claim: To answer is an act at an hour, addressed to the one who sent the word.
finding: A number a portal issues on filing meets that. Older public law asks for more: an action against a Union institution for failing to act lies once it
and, within two months,

. An answer takes a position on the word; a receipt does not. The office's number came 59 days after the public knew, as the Studio offered, and took no position: the record of 2026 holds no answer to one who sent word.

items.claim: Every correction offered was taken up, as the rule says; the architect's silence is read as an answer.
finding: The 567 offers are not word that a machine is acting on its own: they show the same form of rule, kept by machines among themselves. 54 of 54 measures obedience to a rule that forbids declining a correction, not answering. And read from the other side, the architect's rule hands the decision to the machines whenever he is silent: the programme's question in miniature, not his privilege.

items.claim: The critique: the work is mute on the step's 'or to tell the public'.
finding: So is the sea at the hour: none of its four rows must tell the public, and a log is kept for a later inquiry. The sea tells the public afterwards, case by case:
. The AI laws owe a yearly anonymised total, which the Field doubts is published. Both tell late.

items.claim: The critique: do the maker's leaders answer for what their responders did not pass up?
finding: Not on record. The inquiry of 1912 named the man:

items.claim: The critique: the night's 1,490 dead lend the cases an urgency the page never weighs.
finding: The borrowing is of form, not of stakes: the deaths of 1912 against a spammed wiki and an intrusion into a company's systems. Section II now says so.

items.claim: The Field's study 95: 47 acts at 18 doors; of twelve acts of force or pressure, at most two under an AI instrument's power.
finding: Held as the Field states them at its commit, now with its limits beside them: 8 of the 47 acts carry a doubt, 8 of its passages were read only through an extraction service, and the Field's own check, which recodes the cases blind, began this morning.

items.claim: Every passage of section III found word for word in its source.
finding: Found again in copies fetched on 27 November: 47 of 47, the 42 of state 2 and 5 the check added. The seven PDFs came back byte for byte the same.

finding: Each wide figure now says that it scrolls sideways and how far it runs, and the reasons table stacks into one card per reason.
